PSYCH-K® Preferred Facilitator • Mindset Coaching • Subconscious Belief Transformation

Anna O’Driscoll is a PSYCH-K® Preferred Facilitator based in Brisbane, Queensland, supporting people to transform stress, limiting beliefs and subconscious patterns so they can respond to life's challenges and opportunities with greater peace, confidence and ease.

Anna discovered PSYCH-K® during her own search for greater happiness, fulfilment and freedom from stress. After many years of experiencing anxiety and depression, she explored meditation, yoga, mindset work, Law of Attraction coaching, brain plasticity and epigenetics before discovering PSYCH-K® and the field of energy psychology.

What began as a personal journey became a passion for helping others.

Anna has completed all levels of PSYCH-K® training, including:

• Basic PSYCH-K®
• Advanced PSYCH-K®
• Master Facilitation
• Health & Wellbeing Program

She brings both extensive training and personal experience to her work, using PSYCH-K® to help clients identify and transform subconscious beliefs and perceptions that may be keeping them stuck.

🌸 WHAT IS PSYCH-K®?

PSYCH-K® is a process designed to help people work with subconscious beliefs and perceptions using a series of processes known as “Balances”.

Sessions incorporate techniques including muscle testing, whole-brain integration, transforming the perception of stress and clarifying goals for the subconscious mind.

Anna's work focuses on helping clients explore what may be underneath the challenges they are experiencing and create new, more supportive beliefs aligned with what they consciously want for their lives.

🌿 WHAT CAN YOU WORK ON?

PSYCH-K® sessions can be tailored to your individual goals and circumstances.

Clients may choose to explore areas such as:

• Stress and anxiety
• Limiting beliefs
• Self-confidence and self-worth
• Personal power
• Relationships
• Career and life direction
• Grief and loss
• Prosperity and abundance
• Health and wellbeing
• Life transitions
• Emotional blocks
• Repetitive thought patterns
• Fear and resistance
• Personal growth and fulfilment

Anna's sessions are gentle, relaxed and personalised to the individual.

✨ 90-MINUTE PSYCH-K® SESSION

AUD $220
A 90-minute session allows time to explore your current situation, clarify what you would like to address and work through an appropriate combination of PSYCH-K® processes.

Sessions may include:

• Muscle testing
• Whole-brain integration
• Transforming the perception of stress
• Goal clarification
• Identifying subconscious beliefs and programs
• Creating new supportive beliefs

🌸 3 × 90-MINUTE SESSION PACKAGE

AUD $597
A three-session package is recommended when you'd like to explore a persistent concern more deeply or have several areas you'd like to work on.

Sessions can be used to explore different layers of stress, beliefs and patterns as they arise.

Save $63.

Sessions must be completed within 3 months.

🌹 TOTAL TRANSFORMATION PACKAGE

10 × 90-MINUTE SESSIONS — AUD $1,797
A deeper opportunity to explore subconscious programming across multiple areas of life.

The package can be used to work on areas such as:

• Self-esteem
• Personal power
• Relationships
• Prosperity
• Health and wellbeing
• Career
• Grief and loss
• Spirituality
• Personal growth

You can choose which PSYCH-K® processes you'd like to explore throughout your sessions and space them according to your needs.

Fortnightly sessions work well for many people.

Save $403.

Sessions must be completed within 6 months.

💫 FREE 15-MINUTE INTRODUCTORY CHAT

Not sure whether PSYCH-K® is right for you?

Anna offers a complimentary 15-minute, no-pressure conversation where you can ask questions, discuss what you'd like to address and learn what you can expect from a PSYCH-K® session.

It is also an opportunity for you and Anna to see whether working together feels like the right fit.

texts.text:
Anna's work is centred around helping people recognise that they are not broken or incapable when life isn't working the way they'd like.

Through PSYCH-K®, she supports clients to explore subconscious beliefs and patterns that may be influencing how they experience stress, relationships, confidence, goals and everyday life.

Her intention is to help people create greater internal peace, confidence, clarity and freedom so they can move forward with less resistance and more ease.

📞 BOOK WITH ANNA

Ready to explore PSYCH-K®?

You can book a session, arrange a complimentary introductory chat or contact Anna directly.

📱 0410 331 835

✉️ anna@perceivebelieve.com.au

🌐 www.perceivebelieve.com.au


🌏 ONLINE & IN-PERSON SESSIONS
Anna works with clients both locally and internationally.

📍 IN PERSON

Shop 4/398 Tarragindi Rd
Moorooka QLD 4105

In-person appointments are available on selected days, with additional options sometimes available depending on clinic availability.

🌏 ONLINE

Remote sessions are available globally via Zoom.

Anna works on Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) and can arrange a mutually convenient time for clients in other time zones.


✨ PERCEIVE BELIEVE

PSYCH-K® • Mindset • Subconscious Beliefs • Personal Transformation

“Transform stress. Create supportive beliefs. Experience more peace, confidence and ease.”
